method: Real AgentCore responses to a controlled review scenario. Historical Square change; mapping confidence deliberately lowered from high to low. Reviewer decisions are simulated, not customer validation.

routine.what_maya_calls_it: Stock moving between the counter and the website
routine.in_her_words: Everything is in one pile. If someone buys the last lamp in the shop the website has to know within the hour or I sell it twice and have to write to somebody and apologise. It goes the other way too when we move a pallet up from the unit.
routine.if_it_stops: Nothing looks wrong. The website keeps selling. I find out when two people have bought the same thing.
routine.how_late_would_she_notice: a few days, when the second customer complains
routine.what_it_costs: A refund, an apology, and a review. In December it is worse because the counter is busy and nobody is watching the numbers.

Your stock sync will stop working if it hasn't already, and you'll sell the same thing twice without knowing.

Your till and bookings removed a call on 14 July 2026. A developer has reviewed this case and confirmed that your stock sync routine does use that call, so the routine will have stopped working when the call was removed.

When it happened: today, 14 July 2026
What it costs you: A refund, an apology, and a review. In December it is worse because the counter is busy and nobody is watching the numbers.
How late you would normally find out: A few days, when the second customer complains.
